speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) whether EMA has the responsibility to ensure that electricity retailers uphold the Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 when they exit the market; (b) if so, whether EMA sets a standard for compensation when an electricity retailer exits the market; and (c) whether a transparent method to determine a fair standard can be made known.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: For instance, retailers must provide a consumer advisory and fact sheet to summarise the key terms of the retail plans, for consumers to acknowledge such information before signing contracts with the retailers.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Consumers are also free to switch to other retailers of their choice.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Consumers who wish to seek recourse from their electricity retailers can approach the Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE), Singapore Mediation Centre or Small Claims Tribunal (SCT), for advice and assistance.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: So, it does appear that some retailers are providing ex-gratia compensation upon appeal, and when people write in and request a compensation.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Going forward, will the Government consider "template-tising" that and setting a standard for what sort of compensation should be paid so that people who write appeals do not get the benefits that other people who do not write appeals get?

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: Indeed, that is one of the considerations that we are also considering.

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: As I have shared earlier on, EMA is conducting a review in terms of how we can further strengthen the framework and also to ensure that in a very unprecedented crisis, such as this, what other measures will we be able to leverage on to support our general population and also many of the SMEs at large.
